rows: What did tube paint specifically enable?
Plein air (outdoor) oil painting — portability + hours of usable paint without preparation
What year were tin paint tubes invented?
What two developments made Impressionism materially possible?
Tube paint (1841) — portability for plein air — and synthetic ultramarine (1826) — affordable blue at scale. Cadmium and viridian expanded the palette but were secondary.
Why does the cadmium series span yellow to red?
Mixed CdS₁₋ₓSeₓ — continuous band gap tuning with selenium substitution for sulfur
Heavy use of lake pigments (organic chromophore on alumina substrate) — ASTM II lightfastness
Additive mixing at distance: small dots of pure pigment optically blend like RGB light, not like CMYK paint
Mauveine — first synthetic dye from coal tar (1856) — and effectively founded the modern chemical industry
Why did zinc white cause cracking in paintings?
Brittle oil film + zinc soap formation → structural weakness in thick applications
